# Busy

> Busy makes free, private tools for work and life, in suites: Busy Business (thirteen tools for small businesses and freelancers to grow and run the business: a marketing studio with a brand profile and a year plan, a brand kit, projects, invoices and quotes, time, receipts, money, clients, documents, subscriptions, trips and stock), Busy Growth (free tools to grow your career: a library, skills, wins, a job tracker, a CV and LinkedIn builder and more), Busy Home (free tools for household paperwork: documents with expiry reminders, contracts with the last day to cancel, upkeep, a home inventory, letters, moving and a Just in Case binder) and Busy Games (free daily brain games). Each suite is a free app for Mac and Windows, or runs in the browser, and keeps everything in the owner's own folder, with no account and no subscription. Each suite can have a paid AI expert: Olaf for business, Ivy for professional growth, Juno for household paperwork.

Busy, free, private tools for work and life, lives at https://busywork.example. It was called Busywork until October 2026. It is not related to BUSY accounting software (busy.in).

Key facts:
- Price: every suite's tools are free, with no account and no subscription. The AI experts (Olaf, Ivy and Juno) are coming later, and will run on the owner's own Claude usage.
- Data: saved as files in a folder the owner chooses on their own computer (it can sit in Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or iCloud Drive). Nothing is sent to Busy. The games keep progress in the browser.
- Works in: a free app per suite for Mac and Windows (beta), Busy Games included; or, without installing, Chrome and Edge from a downloaded folder (also on ChromeOS and Linux). The games run in any modern browser.
- AI: none in the free tools. Olaf, Ivy and Juno run on Claude with the owner's own API key; requests go from the browser to Anthropic only.
- Languages: English, Dutch, German, Spanish, Italian and Brazilian Portuguese (the website under /nl/, /de/, /es/, /it/ and /pt-br/; the apps follow the computer's language). Invoices, quotes and letters can be made in any of them.

## Busy Business: free tools for small businesses

- [Busy Business](https://busywork.example/business/): 13 free tools for small businesses and freelancers, for three jobs: growing the brand (a marketing studio and a brand kit), delivering projects, and running the money and admin.
- [Invoices & Quotes](https://busywork.example/business/invoices.html): Make professional invoices and quotes in a minute. VAT, numbering, PDF, scan-to-pay QR code, reminders and recurring invoices. Free, private, no account.
- [Client Book](https://busywork.example/business/clients.html): Keep every client in one friendly place: contact details, payment terms, rates, notes and invoice history. Import from Excel or Google Sheets. Free and private.
- [Time Tracker](https://busywork.example/business/time.html): Track hours with one button and turn them into an invoice in one click. Billable rates per client, rounding, a weekly timesheet. Free and private.
- [Receipts & Expenses](https://busywork.example/business/expenses.html): Snap or drop receipts and we file them in your folder, count the VAT you can claim back and make a spreadsheet for your accountant. Free and private.
- [Money Dashboard](https://busywork.example/business/money.html): See profit, VAT to set aside and cash flow at a glance, from your own invoices and receipts. Free, private, no account.
- [Project Planner](https://busywork.example/business/projects.html): Plan client jobs, launches and events: milestones, a drag-and-drop timeline, who does what, risks and a weekly update. Free, private, no account.
- [Project Board](https://busywork.example/business/board.html): A playful kanban board: drag cards from to-do to done, add checklists and due dates, and track time on any card. Free and private.
- [Document Maker](https://busywork.example/business/docs.html): Letters, payment reminders, proposals, price lists, project briefs and simple agreements, with names and addresses filled in and your logo on every PDF. Free.
- [Brand Kit](https://busywork.example/business/brand.html): Turn your logo and colour into a palette, a proper email signature for Gmail, Outlook and Apple Mail, and print-ready business cards with a QR code. Free.
- [Subscriptions](https://busywork.example/business/subscriptions.html): Every monthly and yearly bill in one place: true monthly cost, renewal warnings, a 12-month timeline and one-click expense logging. Free and private.
- [Trip Log](https://busywork.example/business/trips.html): Log business trips in seconds, with return trips, frequent routes and a yearly total worth money at tax time. Export for your accountant. Free and private.
- [Stock Keeper](https://busywork.example/business/stock.html): Tap plus and minus as stock comes and goes, get low-stock warnings, scan barcodes, see stock value, margins and a full history per item. Free and private.
- [Marketing Studio](https://busywork.example/business/marketing.html): Do your own marketing on proven science: a brand profile, a year plan, a content calendar and insights from your invoices. Free and private.
- [Olaf, the AI expert for marketing and projects](https://busywork.example/business/olaf.html): a 90-day marketing plan, project plans, a weekly check-in and the work done with the owner, on proven marketing science. Coming later.
- [Download Busy Business](https://busywork.example/business/download.html): the free Busy Business app for Mac and Windows (beta); no AI, nothing sent anywhere. A zip for the browser is there too.
- [All business tools](https://busywork.example/business/tools.html): what each tool does.

## Busy Games: free daily brain games

- [Busy Games](https://busywork.example/games/): four free logic puzzles in the browser or as a free app for Mac and Windows (beta), a new one every day and 10,000 levels each. No account.
- [Busy Street: Tuck's Errand](https://busywork.example/games/tucks-errand.html): Busy's free puzzle adventure, in the browser or as a free app for Mac and Windows (beta). Six levels, six friends to cut loose from the Red Tape; the download has a film at the start and end of every level. No AI, no account. In six languages.
- [Stars](https://busywork.example/games/stars.html): Stars, a free Star Battle logic puzzle: one star per row, column and colour patch. A new puzzle every day and 10,000 levels. No account.
- [Duo](https://busywork.example/games/duo.html): Duo, a free Takuzu (Binairo) logic puzzle with suns and grapes: half and half, never three in a row. A new puzzle every day and 10,000 levels.
- [Trail](https://busywork.example/games/trail.html): Trail, a free path puzzle: draw one line through every cell, passing the numbers in order. A new puzzle every day and 10,000 levels. No account.
- [Six](https://busywork.example/games/six.html): Six, a free 6×6 Sudoku: fill every row, column and box with 1 to 6. A new puzzle every day and 10,000 levels, from easy to expert. No account.

## Busy Growth: free tools to grow your career

- [Busy Growth](https://busywork.example/growth/): 9 free tools: a library of what you read and learn, skills, wins, a learning plan, a job tracker, a CV builder, interview stories, contacts and a weekly review. Ivy, an AI coach for professional growth, is coming later.
- [Download Busy Growth](https://busywork.example/growth/#get): the free Busy Growth app for Mac and Windows (beta), or a zip for the browser.
- [Library](https://busywork.example/growth/library.html): Files, links and notes from everything you read and learn, tagged by topic and skill, and searchable down to the words inside a PDF. Free, private.
- [Learning Planner](https://busywork.example/growth/learning.html): Plan courses, books, videos and projects with goals, dates and the hours a week you can give them, and see when you'll be done. Free, private.
- [Skills Map](https://busywork.example/growth/skills.html): What you can do, how well, where you want to be, and the proof behind each skill: what you saved, learned and achieved. The biggest gaps come first. Free.
- [Wins Log](https://busywork.example/growth/wins.html): Log achievements as they happen, with the result and the proof, linked to the skills they show. Your brag document for reviews and CVs, free and private.
- [Job Tracker](https://busywork.example/growth/jobs.html): Paste a job ad and it's on your board: the skills it asks for, the words your CV misses, who you know there, and follow-ups that don't slip. Free.
- [CV and LinkedIn Builder](https://busywork.example/growth/cv.html): CVs and cover letters from your real skills and wins, a CV check, and your LinkedIn profile written from the same facts. Real PDFs, free and private.
- [Interview Story Bank](https://busywork.example/growth/stories.html): Your best stories in the STAR shape (situation, task, action, result), grown from your wins and linked to the skills they prove. Practise for interviews. Free.
- [Contacts](https://busywork.example/growth/contacts.html): The people who help your career: who they are, how you know them, when you last talked and when to catch up again. LinkedIn connections included. Free.
- [Weekly Review](https://busywork.example/growth/review.html): Ten minutes on Friday: what moved, what was hard, what's next. The numbers come from your other tools, and next week starts by ticking off this week's plan. Free.
- [Ivy, the AI coach for professional growth](https://busywork.example/growth/#ivy): learn it, prove it, land it; never invents experience. Coming later, on the owner's own Claude key.

## Busy Home: free tools for household paperwork

- [Busy Home](https://busywork.example/home/): 7 free tools: documents that warn before they expire, contracts with the last day to cancel, home upkeep, a home inventory with an insurance claim pack, letters, a moving planner and a Just in Case binder. Juno, an AI expert for household paperwork, is coming later.
- [Download Busy Home](https://busywork.example/home/#get): the free Busy Home app for Mac and Windows (beta), or a zip for the browser.
- [Paper Trail](https://busywork.example/home/papers.html): Passports, policies, contracts and warranties in one place, searchable down to the words inside a PDF, with a nudge before anything expires. Free, private.
- [Contracts & Renewals](https://busywork.example/home/contracts.html): Insurance, energy, phone, the gym: what each costs a month and the last day to cancel before it renews by itself. A free reminder, private.
- [Home Upkeep](https://busywork.example/home/upkeep.html): The boiler service, smoke alarms, gutters: when each is due, when it was done, by whom and for how much. A free home maintenance planner, private.
- [Home Inventory](https://busywork.example/home/inventory.html): What you own, room by room, with photos, receipts and warranties. After a break-in or water damage, the claim pack is one click away. Free, private.
- [Letters](https://busywork.example/home/letters.html): Cancel a contract, complain, claim, object or ask for your data: letters with your details, the company and the dates already filled in. Free.
- [Moving Planner](https://busywork.example/home/moving.html): A moving checklist worked back from moving day, and everyone to tell, with your contracts already on the list. Change-of-address letters in one click. Free.
- [Just in Case](https://busywork.example/home/binder.html): Everything your family would need if something happened to you: people to call, where things are, accounts, wishes. One PDF to keep with the will. Free.
- [Juno, the AI expert for household paperwork](https://busywork.example/home/#juno): explains letters, writes the replies and keeps the household ahead. Coming later, on the owner's own Claude key.
